en: HEADLINE: yesterday's four-metric GSC improvement was given back in one cycle - clicks 44 -> 43, impressions 1,203 -> 1,188, CTR 3.7% -> 3.6%. Average position held at 30.8, the only headline metric that did not move.

TWO ARTICLES WENT LIVE TODAY - the first double publication in this series. /articles/3d-rendering-for-home-renovation-australia (2,004 words) and /articles/house-renovation-3d-design-adelaide (2,148 words), both shipping with FAQPage and 22-23 internal links. The anchor text is boilerplate SEO-service copy ('Scale dxliving.com with high-quality backlinks, guest posts...', 'Rank SEO Masters', 'Site Rank Academy'). DR and UR are still 0 and every link is UR<10, so nothing is passing authority - but this needs a human decision on whether to disavow.

7-DAY ENGAGEMENT FELL FOR A THIRD STRAIGHT WEEK: 43.24% -> 31.58%, average time per session 21s -> 7s, on rising volume (111 -> 133 sessions). Zero key events across both 7-day windows for a FOURTEENTH scan.

The 28-day key-event count itself fell 7 -> 5 as two older conversions aged out of the window. All 5 remaining are attributed to Organic Search; Direct (208 sessions) and Organic Social (197) have produced none.

SPEED: the /articles hub took 2,006 ms on its cold first fetch - the first page over one second since 13 Sep. Four cache-busted re-reads came back at 338/378/287/315 ms, so it is a cold-cache miss on a hub that just grew by two articles, not a sustained regression. Site mean 309 -> 346 ms, median 252 -> 279 ms, and 113 of 114 pages are still under one second.
Article pages themselves stayed fast: mean TTFB 314 ms across 91 articles, slowest 500 ms.

GSC Page indexing did NOT rebuild for a FIFTH day - still the 14 Sep build, indexed 76 / not indexed 146, all eight reasons identical to the digit. 'Blocked by robots.txt' is still 20 and cannot be diagnosed URL by URL until Google rebuilds.
Google's last sitemap read is still 13 Sep at 109 pages while the live sitemap declares 115 - the gap widened by two today.

Every commercial non-brand query is STILL on zero clicks across the whole 28-day window. Four tracked queries moved and all four moved the wrong way: 3d rendering melbourne 44.9 -> 46.0, 3d renders for builders melbourne 13.1 -> 13.6, 3d renders for developers melbourne 34.1 -> 34.8, 3d renders for property developers melbourne 30.0 -> 30.5. 3d rendering services melbourne is absent for a third day.
Brand still carries the search channel: 35 of 43 clicks (81.4%) are dxliving / dx living / dx_models, and 18 of the 18 page-one queries are brand terms except 'i want 3 months'.

THE ADELAIDE CLUSTER IS NOW SEVEN ARTICLES DEEP for exactly one query in the GSC table (best house builders adelaide, position 38.0, one impression). Publishing more Adelaide pages is not moving Adelaide.
